items.title: [平台] 加一个新平台的读取命令（含分步指引）
items.summary: 想让它支持一个新平台？这个任务的骨架已经现成，按下面走，第一次贡献也能完成： 1. 先开一条「新平台建议」issue（平台名＋链接＋用途），过一下选站红线（政治/宗教/违禁、政务机构、实名敏感数据类不入）； 2. 照 clis/douyin/detail.js 的骨架写一个命令文件，放到 clis/ < 站名 / 下； 3. 本地跑一次，把跑通的样例与返回结构（贴输出）附在 PR 里； 4. 更新 README.md 表格与 平台状态表.md 对应行。 难在第一步之后的探索，不难在写代码——命令框架已经把浏览器会话、参数解析、输出格式都处理好了。

items.title: [文档] README.en.md 校对与表达改进
items.summary: README.en.md 是英文全文版（与中文版互为镜像）。 欢迎挑毛病： - 表达不地道、术语前后不统一、不通顺 - 与 README.md 中文版的事实或数字不一致 一次改一句也行，小 PR 优先。 边界：只改表达，不改事实与边界描述（合规、能力范围、平台清单以中文版为准）。

items.title: [实测] 补一个平台的「最后实测日期」（不用写代码）
items.summary: 平台状态表有一列「最后实测日期」，约定每周日刷新。 如果你常用某个平台，欢迎来帮这列保持新鲜： 1. 按 README 安装（ bash install.sh ），跑 2-3 条你常用平台的命令（低频、单条即可）； 2. 打开 平台状态表.md ，把对应行的日期改成你今天实测的日期，实测结果若有变化一并改； 3. 提 PR。 好消息：不需要写代码。跑不通也没关系——顺手开一个「命令失效」issue 也是贡献。

items.summary: 任务 ：写一个最小 GitHub Actions 片段放入 README： 1. checkout + setup-node + npm ci 2. npm run build && node dist/cli.js --path . --strict 3. 失败时用 actions/upload-artifact 上传 --json 报告 并链接到 .github/workflows/ci.yml 的 self-scan job 作为可运行参考（那个 job 用的就是 --path . --strict ）。 验收 ：片段可直接复制运行；与现有 CI 行为一致；链接有效。 为什么适合新人 ：纯文档贡献，但能真实帮助采用者，也是熟悉项目的第一路径。

items.title: CLI 增加 --quiet（只输出评分一行）

items.title: Phase binning never uses bin 0
items.summary: np.ceil(phase / binsize) on [0, 2π) gives bins 1..K, so bin 0 is never used and states are encoded in base K+1. Results are unaffected, but it's confusing. n bins is also inferred from phase.max() rather than passed in. Fix: use floor with clip(0, K - 1) and pass n bins explicitly.

items.title: audit.jsonl 与 state.jsonl 轮转 + 归档 + verifier 适配（MVP 部署前置）
items.summary: Daedalus 的 audit 与 state 日志均为追加写，当前无轮转、无 size cap、无归档策略。长跑主机上这两个文件会持续增长，并在一年内把 /var 占用推到几 GB 量级。本 issue 跟踪三件缺失能力：轮转、归档、verifier 跨归档读取。 Problem - audit.jsonl ： daedalus-sdk/audit 以单文件哈希链追加写， files/system/usr/lib/systemd/system/daedalus-audit.service 将文件置为 chattr +a （append-only）。文件既无 size cap，也无轮转入口。 - state.jsonl ：观测缓存，同为追加写，同样无轮转。 - 单机长跑一年，audit 行数落在数十万至百万量级，单文件能涨到几百 MB 至几 GB。 - chattr +a 拒绝 unlink / rename /…

items.title: truncate() output is longer than the limit
items.summary: truncate("abcdefghij", 5) returns "abcde..." , which is 8 characters. The result, including the ... , should be at most limit characters long. Text that already fits must be returned unchanged.

items.title: parse duration() ignores seconds
items.summary: parse duration("1m30s") returns 60 instead of 90 . The s unit is accepted by the pattern but contributes nothing. parse duration("45s") returns 0 .

items.title: word count() miscounts extra whitespace
items.summary: word count("hello world") (two spaces) returns 3 , and word count("") returns 1 . Words separated by any amount of whitespace, including tabs and newlines, should count once: word count("one\ttwo\nthree") should be 3 . Empty or whitespace-only text has 0 words.

items.title: chunk() drops the last partial chunk
items.summary: chunk([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2) returns [[1, 2], [3, 4]] . The trailing 5 is silently lost. Expected [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]] . Any leftover items should end up in a final, shorter chunk.

items.title: slugify() leaves repeated and trailing dashes
items.summary: slugify("Hello, World!") returns "hello--world-" . Expected "hello-world" . Any run of characters that are not letters or digits should become a single dash, and the slug should never start or end with a dash.

items.title: Use real PDF.js viewports in annotated export tests
items.summary: Describe the feature Annotated PDF tests generate real PDFs but simulate the source viewport. Real PDF.js fixtures are needed to verify label and measurement placement with CropBox, rotation and UserUnit.

items.title: Cover malformed project files and size boundaries
items.summary: Describe the feature Project-file tests lack a complete matrix for invalid UTF-8, empty or oversized metadata lengths, invalid metadata types and PDFs over the size limit. These rejection paths need direct coverage.

items.title: Cover PDF loading failures and task cleanup
items.summary: Describe the feature PDF loading tests mainly cover file validation and successful loads. Password-protected files, parser failures and loading-task destruction after failure need direct coverage.

items.title: Cover IME and auxiliary mouse buttons in browser tests
items.summary: Describe the feature Simulated interaction tests miss Enter during IME composition and right-click selection through Konva. Browser tests should cover these events and verify that unfinished text and existing selections are preserved.

items.title: Test numerical conservation across geometry and scale operations
items.summary: Describe the feature Numerical tests miss failures in translation, saving an unchanged ratio, copying a valid scale and converting positive quantities. Add coverage that preserves representable results across these operations, including accepted extreme values.

items.title: Test Undo and Redo through the real measurement panels
items.summary: Describe the feature Current tests miss unchanged classification and scale commands that clear Redo, and multi-page visibility actions that create several Undo steps. These paths need tests using the real panels and state providers.

items.title: Cover project replacement after storage failures
items.summary: Describe the feature Storage failure tests cover only some combinations of initial reads, first saves and project replacement. Opening a saved project and choosing Continue without recovery need regression coverage for these failures.

items.title: Moving a Cloud to large coordinates reverses its scallops
items.summary: Describe the bug Translating a clockwise 1-by-1 Cloud to coordinates around 1e8 reverses its scallops from outward to inward. Numerical cancellation changes the detected winding even though the shape itself is unchanged.

items.title: Copy scale rejects a valid extreme calibration
items.summary: Describe the bug Copying a valid calibration with a factor of 1e308 produces Infinity while creating its temporary reference. The copy is rejected even when the destination is a normal A4 page.

items.title: Right-clicking a measurement changes the selection
items.summary: Describe the bug Right-clicking a visible measurement in Select mode changes the selection. The shape handler bypasses the viewer's primary-button check, so subsequent actions can affect an unexpected selection.

items.title: Large label coordinates stall annotated PDF export
items.summary: Describe the bug On an accepted page of 1e20 by 1e20, a Count at (5e19, 5e19) makes annotated PDF export repeatedly insert into the same label-grid cell. The calculation stalls before throwing RangeError.

items.title: Extreme PDF dimensions bypass raster memory limits
items.summary: Describe the bug A 578-byte PDF with dimensions of 1e20 by 1e20 is accepted by PDF.js but requests a 493-million-pixel raster, exceeding the 16.8-million-pixel budget. The minimum raster scale overrides the memory limits.

items.title: Unit conversion turns a positive measurement into zero
items.summary: Describe the bug With an accepted reference distance of 5e-324 mm, a positive measurement becomes zero when converted to metres. The UI, CSV and spreadsheet measurement tables report zero instead of flagging the unrepresentable conversion.

items.title: A finite polygon area is rejected after an intermediate overflow
items.summary: Describe the bug An imported rectangle measuring 1e154 by 1e154 at scale 1 has a finite area of 1e308. The calculation doubles that area before dividing by two, overflows and rejects the result.

items.title: Extreme XY scales make a positive ellipse area become zero
items.summary: Describe the bug An ellipse measuring 1e-14 by 1 page unit with XY scales of 1e-310 and 1e150 returns an area of zero. Its correct positive area is representable, and the project accepts these values.

items.title: Saving an unchanged small scale ratio changes measurements
items.summary: Describe the bug Set ratio rounds a valid ratio of 1.23456e-15 to 1e-15. Saving without editing changes the scale and reduces the resulting measurements by about 19%.

items.title: Enter saves text before IME composition finishes
items.summary: Describe the bug Pressing Enter to confirm IME composition also saves and closes the page-label and measurement-name editors. The unfinished text can be committed before composition ends.

items.title: Cloud snapping misses the visible outline
items.summary: Describe the bug Snap uses a Cloud's control polygon instead of its visible scalloped outline. Points near the visible arcs can fail to snap, while points near invisible control segments can snap.

items.title: Hiding a group across pages requires several Undo steps
items.summary: Describe the bug Hide all on a measurement group spanning several pages creates one Undo step per page. Undoing once restores only part of the group instead of reversing the whole action.

items.title: Saving an unchanged name clears Redo
items.summary: Describe the bug Saving a scale, classification dimension or classification value without changing its name adds an empty Undo step and clears Redo. The user can no longer redo the previous change.

items.title: Continue without recovery cannot open a PDF when storage is blocked
items.summary: Describe the bug When the initial IndexedDB read fails, Continue without recovery hides the warning but still prevents a PDF from opening. The user cannot start a project despite explicitly choosing to continue without recovery.

items.title: Opening a saved project loses a memory-only project
items.summary: Describe the bug If the current project could not be saved because browser storage is full, opening another project from Projects discards it without confirmation. Its changes are lost and no recoverable copy remains.

items.title: 讚美洪水
items.summary: 「我們今日面對的河流災難，絕大多數都是過去為了謀求智人與民族國家的利益，試圖規訓與馴化河流的結果。我們基於自身目的努力改造河流，特別是簡化河流與整個流域，這正是今日河流的主要病因。」斯科特告訴我們，在智人演化的絕大多數時間裡，都是以採集與狩獵為生，而智人與其他的生物相同，也會跟著「洪水脈動」，調整生活與生命的頻率。然而，當國家開始在河流的沖積平原上出現後，智人與河流的關係有了變化。斯科特寫道：「早期國家必須有集中的定居農業人口與栽種已經馴化的穀物作物才能維持」、「早期國家是一種侵入性的人為秩序。定耕農業、灌溉水田以及讓地面上的穀物同時成熟，這一切全需要將地貌簡化」。在國家的統治下，人們開始栽植愈來愈多的穀物，因為得繳稅，也因此得砍伐愈來愈多的森林。森林的消失影響了河流，生活在沖積平原的人們，開始受到「洪水」之苦。

items.title: Every image is decoded at full size
items.summary: Every image is decoded at its full size. crates/frus-image/src/lib.rs turns the bytes into full-resolution RGBA, whatever the size it will be shown at. A gallery of such photos is how image-heavy apps get killed for memory on low-end Android phones, and it is a common complaint about other toolkits…

items.title: Eval cycle runs full GitHub fan-out even when the installation's core quota is nearly exhausted
items.summary: The governor eval cycle currently performs the full GitHub API fan-out every interval even when the shared GitHub App installation core quota is nearly exhausted. This affects the scan loop and agent-requested work because they share the same 5k/hr installation bucket. When quota runs low, optional sweeps and collectors should be shed and the eval cadence should stretch until the bucket resets.

items.title: 征集用户留言：说说你为什么用 ContiNew
items.summary: 背景 官网首页准备加一块「用户留言」滚动区，只放社区里真实发生的反馈 —— 不代写、不用占位好评撑场面。 想征集什么 一两句话说清： - 你用 ContiNew 的哪个项目做了什么（内部系统 / 客户项目 / 自己的产品？） - 它帮你解决了什么问题、省下了哪一步 - 如果只推荐一个点，你会推荐什么 具体比好听更有用。 「用了三年很棒」不如「代码生成器把新模块的 CRUD 从两天压到两小时」。 怎么留 直接在本 issue 下评论，照下面的格式填： 署名可以是真名也可以是常用昵称；身份那栏是给留言一个可信的落点。 会怎么用 - 精选N条放到 continew.top 首页滚动展示 --- 谢谢每一位愿意花几分钟写下来的朋友。

items.title: auc is very slow with many sessions
items.summary: In pywib 2.1.0, auc geometric deviation ( pywib/utils/movement/trajectory.py ) loops in Python over every optimal path point and every trace segment, calling point to segment distance once per pair. On real data with 48 sessions and 95,000 events, auc alone takes about 17 s. Vectorising that loop with numpy gives the same results in a fraction of the time.

items.title: Find out what the proxy's throughput ceiling actually is
items.summary: Node utilisation peaked at 50% during the meshed runs while throughput was capped, so the ceiling is inside the proxy rather than on the machine. I established that it is not node CPU and then stopped, which leaves the actual question open. What to investigate - does LINKERD2 PROXY CORES (or the equivalent in current releases) change the ceiling? - does setting an explicit CPU request or limit on the injected proxy…

items.title: At what amount of application work does the mesh tax stop mattering?
items.summary: The README's own strongest caveat: nginx returning a fixed string is close to the worst case for a mesh, because the proxy's work is a large fraction of total work. A service that spends 50 ms in a database will show a much smaller relative tax. I believe that, and I did not measure it. The -86% figure is the ceiling of what the proxy can push, not what a real application sees, and anyone quoting it without that…

items.title: Measure Istio, especially ambient mode, with the same harness
items.summary: The README measures one mesh, one version, and says so. The obvious gap is Istio, and specifically ambient mode , which exists precisely because the sidecar model has the cost this repo measures. Ambient replaces the per-pod sidecar with a per-node ztunnel for L4 plus an optional waypoint proxy for L7. items.title: Rebuilding the index on a schema change blocks the app
items.summary: Problem When the index schema changes, LibraryEngine.init rebuilds it synchronously, which takes minutes on a large library and the app shows nothing meanwhile. Idea Open the app immediately, rebuild in the background with a progress indicator in the shelf, and serve queries from the old index until the new one is ready. Where to look LibraryEngine.init , IndexBuilder.rebuild .

items.title: Multipart parsing matches boundary and form-data case-sensitively
items.summary: MultipartFormData matches parameter and token names case-sensitively, but RFC 9110/2045 make them case-insensitive. Content-Type: multipart/form-data; Boundary=xyz does not match boundaryRegex (no IgnoreCase ), so the valid body is rejected with 400. A part with Content-Disposition: Form-Data; name="a" fails StartsWith("form-data", Ordinal) and becomes a plain FormEntry , losing its name and filename. Location…

items.title: Content-Type media type is not trimmed before handler lookup
items.summary: Content-Type: multipart/form-data ; boundary=x (optional whitespace before ; , allowed by RFC 9110) leaves MimeType as "multipart/form-data " with a trailing space. The DataHandler lookup misses, and the body is stored as RawPostData instead of being parsed as multipart. Handlers that expect MultipartFormData or UrlEncodedData silently get no data. Location: MaxLib.WebServer/HttpPost.cs:40-60 Fix: Trim the media…

items.title: word count("") 返回 1，空字符串应返回 0
items.summary: 问题描述 word count("") 返回 1 ，但空字符串里显然有 0 个单词。这个错误会让所有基于 单词数做统计/计费/分页的上层调用全部偏移 1。 复现步骤 实际输出 期望输出 影响范围 - 空输入是最常见边界情况之一（读空文件、前端空提交、CSV 空行都会产生 "" ）。 - 上层若用 word count 做「是否有内容」的判断，会把空文本误判为有内容。 - 用 word count 做计费的场景会多算 1 个词。 根因分析 textkit/stats.py ： "".split(" ") 返回 [''] （含一个空字符串元素的列表），长度是 1。 应该先剥离首尾空白，或改用 text.split() 。 期望修复 word count("") 返回 0 ，其余用例不受影响： 环境 - textkit 0.3.1 - Python 3.10+

items.title: Avoid low-bitrate quality warnings for lossless audio
items.summary: Problem yaatv currently emits its low-bitrate source warning whenever the detected bitrate is below the configured threshold. That warning is useful for lossy sources such as MP3 or AAC, but it can be misleading for lossless formats such as FLAC, ALAC, WAV, or AIFF. A lossless source can have a comparatively low bitrate because of its content or compression efficiency without representing degraded source quality…
